text:
[issue by MindStudioOfficial]
### Minecraft Version

1.21.1 (LTS)

### Mod Loader

Fabric

### Describe the Issue

placing a hopper below a cooking for blockheads oven which has 3 input slots and 3 output slots crashes the server whenever the block is loaded and ticked because it tries to take items from slot 4 of 3 (IndexOutOfBounds)

Downgrading to Balm 21.0.23+fabric-1.21.1 fixes the issue so I suspect [this commit](https://github.com/TwelveIterationMods/Balm/commit/70e446774db228c44a425db4a787bc698ee0d86f) to be the culprit
